verdict.rationale: Org-wide policy enforcement is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator, since team-oriented authenticators could offer admin-managed policies. The evidence shows only per-user features: a user-configured lock screen (PIN, password, FaceID) and sharing individual codes with teammates via temporary links. Nothing documents an admin console or centrally enforced policies for app lock, export restrictions or credential strength across members.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
